about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Chinese Restaurant in Braunfels
about.intro1: our China Restaurant Tong Tong has been your address for Asian culinary delights for over 30 years, and we want to pamper our guests with them. We take up many culinary trends from traditional Asian cuisine, which we got to know on our travels around the globe and brought back to Germany.
about.intro2: On the one hand we prepare our dishes the traditional way, but on the other hand we also distinguish ourselves through our own creations in preparing the food. This variety of our offerings benefits our guests.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: The protection of your personal data is important to us. Since our offer deliberately works without registration, forms or tracking, we only process the data that arises technically when visiting a website. Below we inform you in accordance with Art. 13 GDPR about the processing of personal data.

controller.title: Controller
controller.text: China-Restaurant Tong Tong, represented by Christine Mohr and Thomas Mohr, Europaplatz 2, 35619 Braunfels, phone: +49 (0) 6442 931082.

hosting.title: Hosting & Server Log Files
hosting.text: When you visit this website, our hosting provider automatically processes technical access data (including IP address, date and time, pages visited). The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure and stable operation). This data is not merged and is not used for profiling.

fonts.title: Google Fonts
fonts.text: To display fonts consistently, this website loads Google Fonts (Google LLC, USA). When you call it up, your IP address is transmitted to Google. Further information can be found in Google's privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).

localStorage.title: Local Storage (localStorage)
localStorage.text: Your language selection (German/English) is stored exclusively locally in your browser (localStorage). This data does not leave your device and is not transmitted to us.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you contact us by phone or email, we process your details exclusively to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) lit. b or f GDPR.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
